text: Vincent Bolloré controls Havas N.V.: a 19 February 2026 notification in the Dutch financial-markets authority's register of substantial holdings records V. Bolloré with a total holding of 53.05% of Havas N.V.'s capital and 53.55% of its voting rights, held indirectly through Bollore SE, Compagnie de l'Odet, Compagnie de l'Etoile des Mers and YB6.
short: Vincent Bolloré holds 53.05% of Havas N.V.'s capital and 53.55% of its voting rights (AFM register, February 2026).

source.name: AFM register of substantial holdings and gross short positions – V. Bolloré – Havas N.V. (notification details)
source.quote: Date of transaction 19 feb 2026 Person obliged to notify V. Bolloré Issuing institution Havas N.V.
source.note: The same page's Distribution in percentages table records for this notification a 'Total holding' of '53,05 %' of capital ('Kapitaalbelang') and '53,55 %' of voting rights ('Stemrecht'); its Distribution in numbers table attributes 30,786,476 shares held 'Middellijk (Bolloré SE and Compagnie de l'Odet)', 18,939,732 'Middellijk (Compagnie de l'Etoile des Mers)' and 2,883,663 'Middellijk (YB6)'.
